name: named-library-definitions
body: `library.yaml` defines reusable names in three optional sections. `groups:` declares named accept-lists, referenced from a section declaration's `accepted:` as `@<name>` (for example `accepted: [@content-blocks, chart]`), combinable with literal template names. `field_sets:` declares named field groups, referenced from a template's `fields:` as a sequence entry `- include: <name>`. `types:` declares named field types, referenced as a field's `type: <name>` (for example a `colour` enum). A named definition resolves when the library loads; an unknown `@<name>`, `include:` name or `type:` name is a templates error with a closest-match suggestion (closest-match-suggestions). The three sections are additive to `library.yaml` format 1 — the `format:` value stays 1 (domain.constraint.library-manifest-format-stable).
